objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time-safe Training Dataset Curation from canonical P18-B Decision / Outcome Journal records, with immutable dataset manifests, exact lineage, temporal split governance, deduplication and fail-closed leakage controls while leaving experiment execution to P18-D.
scope: Curate eligible decision/outcome journal pairs into immutable training rows
Require decision and outcome records to be visible by an explicit dataset cutoff time
Preserve session/strategy/model/signal/risk/firewall and evidence lineage in every row
Require one explicit outcome-definition ID/version per curated dataset
Reject unknown decision references, duplicate decisions, duplicate outcomes and conflicting labels
Apply deterministic temporal TRAIN/VALIDATION/TEST split boundaries
Prevent one decision from appearing in multiple splits
Produce deterministic exclusion reasons for ineligible records
Generate content-addressed dataset manifest and row identities
Expose dataset metadata only; do not execute experiments or retraining
tests: Same journal inputs and policy produce identical row and manifest identities
Outcome observed after dataset cutoff is excluded
Decision after dataset cutoff is excluded
Duplicate decision or outcome identity fails closed
Conflicting outcome label for one decision fails closed
One decision cannot appear in more than one split
Exact lineage is preserved in curated rows
No P18-D experiment or training authority is emitted
No broker/exchange, Live/Auto or promotion authority is emitted
P18-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No future-label visibility beyond dataset cutoff
No automatic retraining or experiment execution
rollback: Revert P18-C curation/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P18-B remains canonical complete and P18-D remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Immutable row and dataset manifest identities implemented
Temporal split and leakage controls enforced
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
